name: Jozef
source:
"I'm... so glad that I became a human. Now I can be of help to you, if only a little."

A bear that ended up lost inside the grounds of Rozum castle after he got separated from his mother at a young age.
When he was about to be killed by the soldiers of the castle he was saved by Julia.
Since he was raised by her since he was young he adores Julia like his own mother.
Contrary to his appearance he is a kind person who hates violence. But when he is cornered he shows his true strength and goes into berserk mode.
He loves dark confined spaces and has a special skill to eat even rotten food without getting sick.
